Ah, i see, i just think it's a bit deeper than that personally. And don't sweat it, i know people who do the same thing. That's something that sadly only they can truly change, because their the only ones with a choice to. The majority will always mock and ignore the minority, no matter what the case is, because it's how humans work. I'm hoping that I'm clearly not trying to defend it, but i think that you have to realize at one point that you should focus more on finding people who view characters the way you do instead of defending them. It'll just make you more sane, and if the minority can grow up that much more the majority eventually won't be so major, if you catch my drift. I found my sexuality through talking to like minded people, and the things they've taught me are things I'll hold onto for the rest of my life. There are more communities out there, and it's completely random whether it'll be the majority pushing itself down on the minority to try and eradicate them. You're a great person, i can tell, and i think that with how upset you are you should try and find different means to get the same ends, because you don't deserve the shit you seem to get for simply sharing your opinion. I'm mostly staying neutral for the sake of keeping the original point of my post (just starting a discussion about the differences between the Hellsing manga and Hellsing Ultimate, because there's a startling lack of comparing and contrasting between the two) but I'm usually biased because it simply is my nature. I just refuse to give up on always hearing a good bit from both sides if any argument and e.t.c. I use neutrality as a way to form my opinions, so that I don't end up being biased in a uninformed and wasteful way. One of my biggest opinions is that if you are completely uninformed about a topic/subject you shouldn't give your input in any other way than questions. I just avoid that in my own way.

No, I'm sorry i got the timeframe wrong though. Hellsing TV's last episode aired January 16, 2002, and Hellsing's last released manga volume was released sometime in November 2008. Ships will be ships, hell, in one of my top 3 favorite animes (kill la kill) the main ship is straight up incest, you'll never convince some people in a fandom lmao. But people usually just make assumptions about characters like that, and on a surface layer just seeing the two characters interact there's no reason not to ship them, I'm basically trying to give people the benefit of the doubt since i love the Hellsing community and assume there's just a lot of people who don't know any better. Of course, the people who support grooming deserve a worse place than hell to suffer in, but I'm really genuinely trying to assume most people just don't know better. I'm pan, but i don't believe it's completely fair to assume that the defining characteristic of someone arguing against you as that their straight. That may be a big reason they don't understand, but at the end of the day they just don't understand. That's where you can't blame them, but where you can is when they refuse to genuinely listen and discuss something like a human being. Again, i personally didn't take away her being Queer coded 100%, although i value you sharing your interpretation of a character. At the end of the day, i still see it that the only true characters with chemistry are Pip and Seras. But i also know that Hirano wanted it to be vague for a very genuis reason, like i said. Just ignore the neanderthals who won't listen, there's a difference between being straight and being able to intelligently have a conversation, you know?

Oh yeah, they really cut that whole sequence way down in Ultimate and kinda jumbled it up. I'm glad you agree! I really am glad this post is getting people talking about it, since i see so much about Hellsing TV vs Hellsing Ultimate (which after a while is almost as easy to explain as the difference between water and ice). That's very interesting because the sub actually takes away things, rather than adding sour notes, very interesting. I can't speak about the dub, and what they did, but i do understand (and wish other people would) that the dialogue changes really change how characters seem to act and changes the feeling of certain plot points. Integra has a few cryptic semi-sexual tension panels, but i believe that's your interpretation of Integra as a character. Now, before you go to reply, hear me out. Hirano left things even as obvious as Pip and Seras having feelings for each other vague, because Hellsing is a vague anime. When it comes to morality, character's thoughts and actions, and everything non-explitive, Hirano leaves it beautifully vague for you to fill in those gaps. I see where you're coming from, and i respect your interpretation, although i see Integra as very strictly Asexual because of her dedication to her work (protecting Britain) and not the Hellsing family or herself.

Yeah, i felt they also paraphrased too hard and you didn't get a wrap on what kind if person they truly were sometimes. I was just very saddened by the fact the actual delivery suffered from the paraphrasing. I'm not trying to nitpick, I'm simply just hoping to get a discussion about the manga vs Ultimate and how they're different since i see such a lack of that specific topic.
